references.text: Theological parallel: Use of wine to suppress morality and create an illusion of the future (tomorrow) while living in sin.
Theological parallel: Incest scenes where a father lies with a woman related by blood (daughter-in-law/daughters) without full consciousness, often linked to preserving the family line.
Theological contrast: Prophecy about breaking natural bonds (fathers/children) as punishment, paralleling the historical event of incest (child/father) as sin.
